title: Strict Bound from a Common Lower Bound
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet, let $\ell$ be a list of bit sources, and let $T,t,i,a$ be natural numbers. Define $S=M.k(2T+1)+|\ell|+3$. If $a<tS$ and $tS\le i$, then $a<i$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape alphabet
$\ell$ is a list of bit sources
